history.text:
Act as a Senior Frontend Developer & Expert Systems/Network Engineer. Build a complete, single-page educational website for "Linux & Computer Networking" using ONLY HTML, CSS (<style>), and Vanilla JS (<script>). No frameworks.UI/Design:2-column dark-mode layout (slate background, vibrant code highlights).Sticky left sidebar with live search filter & active tab states; right panel for detailed reading.
Interactive "Terminal Simulator" in code blocks with a "Simulate Command" button showing sample outputs.
Required Modules & Content (include full descriptions & practical examples):
Linux Architecture & FHS: Kernel, Bash Shell, Userspace. In-depth /, /etc, /var, /home, /root, /bin, /sbin, /dev, /proc, /sys. Commands: ls (-la, -lh, -lt), cd, pwd, mkdir -p, rm -rf, cp -r, mv.
Text & Permissions: cat, less, head, tail -f, nano, vim. Processing: grep (-i, -v, -r), awk, sed, wc. Permissions: Octal (755, 644) vs Symbolic (u+x, g-w), chown, chgrp, rwx rules.
Process & System: PIDs, background/foreground (&, bg, fg), ps aux, top, htop, kill -9, pkill. Package managers: apt, yum/dnf. Systemd: systemctl (start, stop, restart, status, enable, disable).
Networking Core: OSI vs TCP/IP layers & encapsulation. IPv4/IPv6, RFC 1918 private ranges, CIDR, subnets, gateways, loopback.
Network Tools & Diag: ip address show, ip link set, ifconfig. Connectivity: ping (ICMP), traceroute/mtr (TTL), ip route show. Ports: netstat -tulpn, ss -tulpn, nc, telnet. DNS: dig (A, CNAME, MX, +short), nslookup.
Security & Firewalls: SSH (sshd_config hardening, ssh-keygen, ssh-copy-id, port forwarding). Firewalls: ufw rulesets, iptables tables/chains.
